name: Spiral Shader Background
description: An animated WebGL spiral background for React: glowing arms wind out from the centre in a three-colour gradient, with a soft halo and a fading rim. Anti-aliased edges, dithered gradients, any number of arms, live settings. One shader, no dependencies, pauses off screen.

props.name: innerColor
props.description: Colour at the heart of the spiral.

props.name: speed
props.description: Turns per second. Negative turns the other way, 0 holds still.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Arm width as a share of the gap between arms.

props.name: softness
props.description: Edge softness of the arms (0 = crisp, anti-aliased).

props.name: size
props.description: Spiral radius as a share of the shorter side.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far the fade-out reaches in from the rim.

props.name: quality
props.description: Render resolution as a share of the screen's (DPR capped at 2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
